label: UNDERSTANDING HIM

points.heading: Don’t chase
points.body: Extra texts usually make the distance bigger.
points.panel: Match his pace for a few days, and live your life.

points.heading: Stay busy with your own plans
points.body: Your life doesn’t pause because he got quiet.
points.panel: Make plans with friends this week.

points.heading: Ask once, calmly
points.body: If you want clarity, one honest question is enough.
points.panel: “I’ve noticed things feel quieter. Everything okay?”

points.heading: Listen to the answer
points.body: If he says he’s not ready, believe him.
points.panel: “Thanks for being honest. I wish you well.”

points.heading: Remember what you want
points.body: Someone who’s right for you will show up consistently.
points.panel: “I want someone who’s glad to be with me.”

close.save: Save this for the quiet days.

caption:
It’s confusing when someone seems interested and then suddenly goes quiet. It’s easy to blame yourself, or to chase harder.

These five calm steps help you respond in a way that protects your peace and your self-worth, whatever happens next. The right person won’t leave you guessing.

Save this for the quiet days, and follow @roundabloom for more.
